agent_report.summary: Implemented scheduled commitments (Issue #16): added a `commitments` list (`{id, text, time, completed}`) to the day shape, made `getDay` normalize missing lists on read (no version bump/migration) and sort commitments by time, updated `dayHasWork`, added a Commitments panel to `index.html` with a native time input and validation message, styled it distinctly (dashed border + time chip vs. priorities' solid border + numbered badge), reworked the 3-panel layout (2-col grid + full-width commitments row at ≥640px, stacked at 360px), added 11 new Playwright tests (32/32 passing) covering all acceptance criteria including the pre-migration localStorage compatibility case, and documented the decisions in DECISIONS.md. Opened PR #17.
